title: Daily Devotional #60
paragraphs: As I read through Luke 16, I am struck by the parable of the shrewd manager. At first glance, it seems like the manager is being praised for his dishonesty, which is confusing and unsettling. However, upon further reflection, I think the true message of the parable is about being shrewd with our resources and using them wisely for the kingdom.

The manager knew that he was going to be fired, so he used his position to benefit himself and ensure that he would have friends to help him after he lost his job. In a similar way, we are all managers of the resources you have given us, such as our time, money, and talents. We know that our time on earth is limited, and we will all face judgment one day. Therefore, we should use our resources wisely to further your kingdom and help others.

The parable goes on to say that we cannot serve both God and money, and that we must choose one or the other. This is a difficult choice, as money can be tempting and alluring. However, we must remember that our ultimate goal is to serve you and store up treasures in heaven, not on earth.

Lord, help me to be shrewd with my resources and use them to further your kingdom. Give me wisdom and discernment when it comes to financial decisions, and help me to always put your priorities first. May I never forget that everything I have comes from you, and may I use it all to bring glory to your name.
